categories.name: Admission to Normal Care
categories.description: Represents the inpatient ward admission pathway via Normal Care, advancing the patient toward discharge while interacting with time-to-treatment softgoals and measured by post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=15 under Goal id=5 (Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward, OR-decomposed).

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Represents the inpatient ward admission pathway via Intensive Care, carrying a negative contribution to minimizing time-to-treatment (Admission IC --[SomeNegative (-25)]--> Minimize time-to-treatment) and measured by post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=16 under Goal id=5 (Patient is admitted to an inpatient ward, OR-decomposed).

categories.name: Release Variant A
categories.description: Represents the discharge pathway Release A, which helps avoid post-discharge deterioration (Release A --[Help (+50)]--> Avoid post-discharge deterioration) and is measured against post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to the declared alternative id=17 under Goal id=6 (Admitted case reaches a captured discharge, OR-decomposed).
